title: Hyperelliptic Analytic Phase 9
objective: Measure and close the matched-work Phase 9 LFunctionInit, prepared central-value, and central-derivative performance gates against pinned PARI while preserving exact model and coefficient provenance.

oracles: PARI/GP 2.18.1-alpha lfuninit and lfun at matched realbitprecision

handoff.summary: Added bounded reusable Arb central-weight Taylor tables keyed only by genus, matched precision, derivative order, and a bucketed universal log-domain. Fresh coefficient-prefix/LFunctionInit cache misses reuse no computed L-value and now run at 15.242 ms/item versus pinned resident PARI at 9.32 ms/item (1.635x) in the corrected 64-bit receipt. The cold 2.201 s table build is timed separately. All Phase 9 gates pass in that receipt: prepared central values 251x, genus-2 derivatives at least 33.35x, and genus-3 derivatives at least 853.74x. The direct one-worker and bounded-four Arb contours remain explicit differential/fallback rows.
risks: The first order-4 64-bit universal table takes about 2.2 seconds to construct; benchmark receipts report it separately and include direct-fallback crossover rows.

The universal interpolation is deliberately nonrigorous analytically: Arb controls arithmetic roundoff, while independent contour and degree-18 versus degree-20 refinement remain the numerical witnesses.
Cross-platform execution still needs integration-host receipts; Windows selects the deterministic single-worker universal path and retains the tested one-worker direct fallback.
Integration must refresh the shared native-export audit and review the hyperelliptic lazy-package byte budget; this lane adds no exported N-API symbol or new native file.
next_steps: Assess a versioned authenticated precomputed order-4 table artifact or bounded parallel table builder to remove the 2.2-second process-cold stage without exceeding package/startup limits.
Regenerate integration-owned native audit/package-budget metadata after cherry-picking this lane.
Run the corrected multi-sample acceptance receipt on bench-1 and cross-platform correctness receipts on Windows x64, Linux arm64, and macOS arm64.
